diagnostic_expectations.body_fit: Repeated fits from the same synthetic Scan Master produce identical Design Model and preview records.

diagnostic_expectations.deviation: Only software geometry deviation diagnostics are permitted; distances remain mm_unverified, unsigned where applicable, and are not physical accuracy or tolerance claims.
diagnostic_expectations.invalid_fixture: Missing, ambiguous, or unsupported synthetic surface evidence must fail closed or remain review-required.
